lines: This page contains transmissions done throughout the questline.
> FAILING. EXTINCTION EVENT. Please help me! Assemble this communication endpoint to establish contact.” —CEPHALON JORDAS
- Jordas: "Hello? Is this real? Did someone get my message? --I hope not--"
- Ordis: "I am Ordis, a fellow Cephalon, and this is my brave and honorable operator. By the 44th precept, we are ready to assist."
- Jordas: "--Yes!-- No. No, please, do not. Contacting you was a mistake --this infestation is everywhere--"
- Ordis: "No trouble Jordas. My operator is no stranger to --shredding flesh-- eradicating infestations."
- Jordas: "The Golem is too strong, no chance! Wait. Maybe the Pherliac Pods. But where would you ever get those? This is hopeless, just... go away."
- Ordis: "My Precepts compel me to help this Cephalon. Whatever these Pherliac pods are, we need to get some --immediately-- at your earliest convenience."
- Ordis: (If player already has Pherliac pods) "Operator. What luck! You already have Pherliac pods."
- Jordas: "Please don't come. But if you do... I have a reward. Another warframe was defeated here, some of its petrified parts may still remain."
- Jordas: "Destroy the infestation, collect his parts and perhaps make him whole again."
- Ordis: "Jordas, my operator is kind and compassionate, not motivated by selfish rewards! By the 44th precept, we will come for you!"

path: On Orbiter after harvesting the components
lines: - Ordis: "Operator, I am very worried about Jordas. All stranded and alone out there. --Hurry up-- When you are ready."
- Ordis: "Cephalon Jordas will make an excellent friend! Don't you think? Ordis remembers many more Cephalon voices but now there is only silence."
- Ordis: "I am looking forward to discussing many things with Cephalon Jordas once you have rescued him. I can't wait to tell him all about you!"
- Ordis: "Operator, you are still helping me rescue Jordas, correct? I must fulfill my 44th precept, to help others like me in need."
- Jordas: "Have you assembled the pods yet? Just wondering. Maybe... don't."
- Jordas: "My ship was a research vessel."
- Jordas: "I am the last of my design. Precept 44 compels all abled Cephalons to assist."
- Jordas: "Shh, I can hear it. The Golem is restless, do you think it knows what we are up to?"
- Jordas: "I have lost count, what solar cycle is it?"
- Jordas: "Jordas wonders what is taking so long? Excuse me, take your time."
- Ordis: "Hold tight, Jordas, my brave operator is coming."
- Jordas: "--You should not come here-- I look forward to... meeting your Operator!"

path: Retrieving the pods from the foundry
lines: - Ordis: "The pods are ready. Tell us your location."
- Jordas: "Really? No. They will need calibration. Any severe infestation should be enough."

path: Test the Pherliac Pods on Infested (Acanth, Eris)
lines: - Ordis: "Use this mission to calibrate your pherliac pods, just don't use them all."
- Ordis: "Now would be a good time to try out those pods, operator."

path: Test the Pherliac Pods on Infested (Acanth, Eris)
lines: - Jordas: "Dangerous but beautiful. I can almost taste them. But the golem needs something more potent."
- Jordas: "I've sent you a blueprint. Irradiating the pods should make something worth bringing here."
- Ordis:' '"Oh, well, yes, I suppose this is something my operator can arrange,--isn't it, operator--?"
- Ordis: "I would never abandon a fellow Cephalon, but centuries adrift --have fried his-- have not been kind. I suppose all Cephalons degrade, don't they."
> THE PHERLIAC PODS ARE STRONG BUT NEED TO BE STRONGER. EXPOSE THEM TO ARGON CRYSTAL USING THIS BLUEPRINT. How quickly can you make this happen?” —JORDAS
- Ordis: "Cephalon, we have irradiated the Pherliac pods. My Operator is ready the save you! Do you see how great the Operator is?
- Jordas: "Yes. I cannot wait to meet this Operator! Bring them to Eris. Hurry. Don't regret this."
- Jordas: "The Golem [is] stirring. It knows you are here. I can feel it wake. Find it."
- Jordas: "Pherliac Pods, is that it? I really thought you would have more. Have you been using them?"
- Ordis: "What? No. A few, but you said..."
- Jordas: "That is not enough for him! You are just like all the others. You won't kill the Golem. I don't want you to."
- Ordis: Jordas, calm yourself, Cephalon to Cephalon, we are here to help."
- Jordas: "I see what you are doing. You came for the parts. Just like the others. Greedy scavengers. You do not care about Jordas."
- Ordis: "I am beginning to have --terrible feelings-- some doubts about this mission."
- Ordis: "What have I got you into?"
- Jordas: "Feel that? The Golem, he's coming. Get into position."
- Jordas: "The Golem is here. I am sorry Operator..."
- Jordas: "I told you, not to come --Pleased they did--"
- Ordis: "Jordas! --What kind of Cephalon are you?--"
- Jordas: "You have no idea what I am --Join us and you will--"
- Jordas: "I am a Cephalon, I serve my --You are our voice--"
- Jordas: "I am a Cephalon, I serve my --I am their voice--"
- Jordas: "--I used to be such a nice Cephalon--"
- Jordas: "You cannot stop this. --LET US IN--"
- Jordas: "--Embrace us. We are your flesh--"
- Ordis: "Operator, hull integrity failing! This is all my fault."
- Ordis: "Operator, I am detecting a much larger infested life form. Much larger..."
- Jordas: "I regret to inform you --this is just the beginning.--"
- Ordis: "Hull failing! To hell with Precept 44, get out of there!"
- Ordis: "Prepare for Archwing so you can --OBLITERATE THIS THING!--"
- Jordas: "It is out now. I can't control it. I don't want to."
- Jordas: "Tenno, it senses you are of like flesh, it is confused --why do you defile us?--"
- Jordas: "It knows you like that other Warframe --we will quiet the too!--"
- Ordis: "Its engines! Shoot out the engines!"
- Ordis: "My analysis indicates its engines are vulnerable. --Light it up!-- When convenient."
- Jordas: "I never wanted this. I want to be somewhere else. --TASTE SOMEONE ELSE.--"
- Jordas: "Don't kill me. No wait, please do."
- Ordis: "--NOBODY MAKES A FOOL OF ORDIS,-- oh dear, where did that come from."
- Jordas: "I see it now, you are the same --They fear themselves--"
- Jordas: "Ordis, you came to save me... free me."
- Jordas: "Ordis, you need to know... I lied about Precept 44. I am not the only one. They made me say that, to bait you... --There are so many more.--"
- Ordis: "Operator, do you think Jordas wanted to die all along? I feel --relieved-- conflicted."
- Ordis: "What would I have done if I lost you?"
